pull.title: build: drop use of `OBJC_OLD_DISPATCH_PROTOTYPES`
pull.body: Now that we target macOS >= `14.0` and use macOS SDK `14.0`, and no-longer use `objc_msgSend`, this can be removed. Was added in #16720.

events.body: The following sections might be updated with supplementary metadata relevant to reviewers and maintainers. ### Code Coverage & Benchmarks For details see: https://corecheck.dev/bitcoin/bitcoin/pulls/36206. ### Reviews See [the guideline](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#code-review) and [AI policy](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/master/doc/AI_POLICY.md) for information on the review process. | Type | Reviewers | | ---- | --------- | | Concept ACK | [hebasto](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36206#pullrequestreview-5166472653) | If your review is incorrectly listed, please copy-paste <!--meta-tag:bot-skip--> into the comment that the bot should ignore.

Concept ACK.

Here is a related [snippet](https://github.com/qt/qtbase/blob/ed77a3ca9ef1bf5e33b6f32ea41110734fb14e88/cmake/QtInternalTargets.cmake#L267-L270) from the Qt 6.8.4 codebase:
```cmake
        # Xcode 14's Clang will emit objc_msgSend stubs by default, which ld
        # from earlier Xcode versions will fail to understand when linking
        # against static libraries with these stubs. Disable the stubs explicitly,
        # for as long as we do support Xcode < 14.
```

build: drop use of OBJC_OLD_DISPATCH_PROTOTYPES

use objc_msgSend, this can be removed.
